title: Why Distributed Is Hard
lines: Episode 1: why distributed systems are hard.
第 1 集：分布式系统难在哪。
A distributed system is one job done by several computers that talk over a network.
分布式系统，就是几台通过网络通信的计算机一起完成一件事。
We'll take one small job, counting words in eight books, and try to spread it across machines.
我们拿一个小任务——数八本书里的词——试着把它分到多台机器上。
By the end, you'll know your way around src/, and which files are yours to write.
看完这一集，你能在 src/ 里认路，也知道哪些文件归你写。
By the end, you'll know your way around the source folder, and which files are yours to write.

title: The Whole Idea First
lines: Here is the whole episode in two sentences.
先用两句话说完这一集。
One machine counts our eight books in a fraction of a second.
一台机器数完八本书，只要零点几秒。
Many machines are how the job scales, and they bring four problems one process never has.
要扩大规模就得用很多台机器，而它们带来四个单进程里从来没有的难题。
Now the page. A, on top: one process. Read the books, Map, sort, Reduce, one output file.
下面是这张图。顶上 A：一个进程。读书、Map、排序、Reduce、一个输出文件。
Many machines are how the job scales, and they bring four problems one process never has.
B, below: the same steps, spread over machines that pass messages.
下面 B：同样的步骤，分到几台互相发消息的机器上。
Marker 1: a machine can die halfway.
标记 1：一台机器可能做到一半就死了。
Marker 2: two machines can write the same file at once.
标记 2：两台机器可能同时写同一个文件。
Marker 3: a message can vanish, and the sender can't tell what happened.
标记 3：一条消息可能消失，发的人分不清发生了什么。
Marker 4: copies of the one record that matters must agree.
标记 4：那份最重要的记录，各个副本必须一致。
And on the right, the five labs. Each one fights one or more of these markers.
右边是五个 Lab，每个都在对付其中一个或几个标记。
visual: A small copy of the page sits in a corner of every later scene, the current part lit.

title: One Machine
lines: Start with the version that needs no network at all: mrsequential.go.
先看完全不用网络的版本：mrsequential.go。
Start with the version that needs no network at all: M R sequential dot go.
The lab hands it to you as the reference answer. It runs everything in one process.
Lab 把它作为参考答案发给你，所有事都在一个进程里做完。
The counting logic lives in a plugin, wc.go: a file of Map and Reduce functions loaded at run time.
计数逻辑在插件 wc.go 里：一个装着 Map 和 Reduce 函数、运行时才加载的文件。
The counting logic lives in a plugin, W C dot go: a file of Map and Reduce functions loaded at run time.
mrapps/wc.go:19–40
Map gets one book's text. It splits on anything that isn't a letter.
Map 拿到一本书的全文，在所有非字母处切开。
It emits one pair per word: the word, and "1".
每个词吐出一对：这个词，和 "1"。
It emits one pair per word: the word, and the string one.
mrsequential loops over the files and appends every pair to one slice, intermediate.
mrsequential 逐个文件读，把所有词对追加进同一个切片 intermediate。
M R sequential loops over the files and appends every pair to one slice, called intermediate.
main/mrsequential.go:38–51
Then it sorts that slice by key, so equal words sit next to each other.
然后按键排序，相同的词就挨在一起。
main/mrsequential.go:59
For each run of equal keys it calls Reduce, which in wc.go just counts the values.
每一段相同的键调用一次 Reduce；wc.go 里的 Reduce 只是数一下有几个值。
For each run of equal keys it calls Reduce, which in W C dot go just counts the values.
main/mrsequential.go:68–84
Each result becomes one line of mr-out-0: the word, a space, the count.
每个结果写成 mr-out-0 的一行：词、空格、次数。
Each result becomes one line of the output file: the word, a space, the count.
main/mrsequential.go:61,81

title: The Real Run
lines: Here is the real run on the eight books in src/main.
这是在 src/main 那八本书上的真实运行。
Here is the real run on the eight books in the main folder.
3.3 megabytes of text. 623,948 words. 22,107 different ones.
3.3 MB 文本，623,948 个词，其中 22,107 个不同的词。
Three point three megabytes of text. Six hundred twenty-three thousand words. Twenty-two thousand different ones.
data.py: data/out sizes.txt, all.txt
The top word is "the", 29,748 times.
最多的是 "the"，29,748 次。
The top word is the, twenty-nine thousand seven hundred times.
And the whole job takes a fraction of a second on one laptop.
整个任务在一台笔记本上只要零点几秒。
data.py: data/out/time.txt (5 runs)
So, a fair question: why would anyone use more than one machine?
那么问题来了：为什么还要用不止一台机器？
So, a fair question: why would anyone use more than one machine?
pause

title: Now Make It a Terabyte
lines: Because real inputs are not 3.3 megabytes. Google's were terabytes.
因为真实的输入不是 3.3 MB。Google 的输入是 TB 级。
Because real inputs are not three megabytes. Google's were terabytes.
Scale our run by hand: one terabyte is about 300,000 times bigger.
按比例手算一下：1 TB 大约是它的 30 万倍。
Scale our run by hand: one terabyte is about three hundred thousand times bigger.
At the same speed, that's over ten hours on one machine. Worked out, not measured.
按同样的速度，一台机器要超过十个小时。这是推算，不是实测。
Worse: mrsequential keeps every pair in memory. A terabyte of pairs won't fit.
更糟的是：mrsequential 把所有词对放在内存里，1 TB 的词对根本装不下。
Worse: M R sequential keeps every pair in memory. A terabyte of pairs won't fit.
The MapReduce paper reports a grep over one terabyte on about 1,800 machines, in about 150 seconds.
MapReduce 论文报告：在约 1800 台机器上 grep 1 TB 数据，用时约 150 秒。
The Map Reduce paper reports a grep over one terabyte on about eighteen hundred machines, in about a hundred and fifty seconds.
Dean & Ghemawat, OSDI 2004, §5.2
That's the goal: speed from many machines. Now let's see what it costs.
这就是目标：靠很多台机器换速度。下面看看要付出什么代价。

title: Two Machines Share Nothing
zh: 两台机器什么都不共享
lines: First, the one fact that makes everything else hard.
先说一个让后面一切都变难的事实。
Two machines, A and B. Each has its own memory. B cannot read A's slice.
两台机器 A 和 B，各有各的内存。B 读不到 A 的切片。
The only link between them is the network. All they can do is send messages.
它们之间唯一的联系是网络，能做的只有发消息。
So A asks B for work the way a program calls a function, except the call travels as a message.
所以 A 让 B 干活，就像程序调用一个函数，只不过这次调用是作为一条消息发出去的。
That's a remote procedure call, RPC: send the arguments, wait for a reply message.
这叫远程过程调用，RPC：把参数发过去，等一条回复消息。
That's a remote procedure call, R P C: send the arguments, wait for a reply message.
In one process, a call always returns. Across a network, the reply might never come.
在一个进程里，调用总会返回；跨网络时，回复可能永远不来。
Hold on to that. All four markers grow out of it.
记住这一点，四个标记都从这里长出来。
visual: Label 玩具例子 / toy. Two boxes, A and B, each with its own memory; a wire between them.

title: Split the Work
lines: The obvious plan: one coordinator hands out books, workers count them.
最直接的方案：一个协调者分发书，几个 worker 去数。
The coordinator is the machine that holds the to-do list and hands out tasks.
协调者就是手里拿着任务清单、负责分活的那台机器。
A worker is a machine that asks for a task, does it, and reports back, all by RPC.
worker 是来要任务、做完、再回报的机器，全都通过 RPC。
A worker is a machine that asks for a task, does it, and reports back, all by R P C.
Eight books, so eight map tasks, spread over a few workers.
八本书，就是八个 map 任务，分给几个 worker。
On paper, this is just mrsequential's loop with the iterations on different machines.
纸面上，这就是把 mrsequential 的循环拆到不同机器上跑。
On paper, this is just the sequential loop with the iterations on different machines.
In practice, every marker on our page now becomes possible. One at a time.
实际上，图上的每个标记现在都可能发生。一个一个来。

title: 1 · A Worker Dies
lines: Worker 2 is halfway through Frankenstein, and its machine loses power.
worker 2 数《弗兰肯斯坦》数到一半，机器断电了。
In one process, a crash ends everything, so there's nothing half-done to clean up.
在单进程里，一崩就全没了，不存在“做了一半”的状态。
Here, the other seven books are fine. Only this task is lost.
这里，另外七本书没事，只丢了这一个任务。
Toy: the coordinator watches a clock. Worker 2 has been quiet for a while. Is it dead?
玩具例子：协调者盯着一个钟，worker 2 已经好一阵没动静了。它死了吗？
pause
It can't know. A dead worker and a slow worker send exactly the same thing: nothing.
它没法知道。死掉的 worker 和慢的 worker 发来的东西一模一样：什么都没有。
The Lab 1 tests make both happen on purpose, with a plugin called crash.go.
Lab 1 的测试故意让这两种情况都发生，用的是一个叫 crash.go 的插件。
The Lab 1 tests make both happen on purpose, with a plugin called crash dot go.
It kills a third of its Map and Reduce calls, and stalls another third for up to 10 seconds.
它让三分之一的 Map / Reduce 调用直接退出，另外三分之一卡住最多 10 秒。
It kills a third of its Map and Reduce calls, and stalls another third for up to ten seconds.
mrapps/crash.go:21–30
How the coordinator recovers is episode 3.
协调者怎么恢复，第 3 集讲。
visual: Corner: marker 1 lit. First a toy clock, then `crash.go`.

title: 2 · Two Writers, One File
zh: 难题 2 · 两个人写同一个文件
lines: Say the coordinator gives up on worker 2 and hands Frankenstein to worker 3.
假设协调者放弃了 worker 2，把《弗兰肯斯坦》交给 worker 3。
But worker 2 was only slow, not dead. Now both are counting the same book.
可 worker 2 只是慢，没有死。现在两个人在数同一本书。
Both write the same output file, at the same time.
两个人同时写同一个输出文件。
A reader could see half of one and half of the other: "Frankenstein" counted 30 times, or 60, or 17.
读的人可能看到一半来自这个、一半来自那个：“Frankenstein”可能数成 30、60，或者 17。
A reader could see half of one and half of the other: Frankenstein counted thirty times, or sixty, or seventeen.
That's concurrency: two things running at once, touching the same data.
这就是并发：两件事同时进行，碰同一份数据。
Inside one machine, the same thing happens between threads, and Go's race detector catches it.
在一台机器内部，线程之间也会这样，Go 的竞争检测器能抓到。
Atomic rename is episode 3; locks and races are episode 4.
原子改名在第 3 集讲，锁和竞争在第 4 集讲。

title: 3 · Did It Arrive?
lines: Back to our RPC. Every step so far is a message, and messages can be lost.
回到 RPC。到目前为止每一步都是一条消息，而消息会丢。
Back to our R P C. Every step so far is a message, and messages can be lost.
The labs simulate the network with labrpc, a fake network inside one process.
Lab 用 labrpc 模拟网络：一个进程里的“假网络”。
The labs simulate the network with lab R P C, a fake network inside one process.
Call sends a request and returns true only if a reply came back.
Call 发出请求，只有收到回复才返回 true。
labrpc/labrpc.go:110–113
In unreliable mode, processReq, which delivers each request, drops it 10% of the time.
在不可靠模式下，负责投递请求的 processReq 有 10% 的概率丢掉它。
In unreliable mode, process request, which delivers each request, drops it ten percent of the time.
labrpc/labrpc.go:290,302
And after the handler has run, it drops the reply another 10% of the time.
处理函数执行完以后，它还会再以 10% 的概率丢掉回复。
labrpc/labrpc.go:349
Both cases end the same way: Call returns false.
两种情况的结局一样：Call 返回 false。
So when you see false, did the server do the work or not?
所以看到 false 时，服务器到底做了没有？
So when you see false, did the server do the work or not?
pause
You can't tell. That one fact shapes the whole KV lab, episodes 5 and 8.
你分不出来。这一个事实决定了整个 KV Lab 的设计，第 5 集和第 8 集讲。
You can't tell. That one fact shapes the whole key-value lab, episodes five and eight.
visual: Corner: marker 3 lit. Picture left (the RPC from scene 5, now dropped at two places), code right.

title: So Far, on the Page
lines: So far, on our page: band A has no markers. Nothing on it can half-fail.
到目前为止，在这张图上：A 带没有标记，那上面没有什么会“坏一半”。
Band B has three already: a dead worker, two writers, a lost message.
B 带已经有三个了：死掉的 worker、两个写的人、丢掉的消息。
All three come from one fact: machines share nothing and only send messages.
三个都来自同一个事实：机器之间什么都不共享，只能发消息。
One marker left, and it's about the coordinator itself.
还剩一个标记，关于协调者本身。
visual: The full framework page. Band A lit grey (no markers), band B with markers 1–3 lit.

title: 4 · The Coordinator Dies
lines: Workers can be replaced. The coordinator can't: it holds the only record of which tasks are done.
worker 可以换人，协调者不行：只有它记着哪些任务做完了。
The natural fix: keep a copy of that record on three machines. Each copy is a replica.
自然的办法是把这份记录在三台机器上各存一份。每一份叫一个副本。
Toy: three notebooks. One says "task 6 done". The other two never heard. Which one is right?
玩具例子：三本笔记本。一本写着“任务 6 做完了”，另外两本没收到。哪本是对的？
Toy: three notebooks. One says task six done. The other two never heard. Which one is right?
pause
Nobody can say, so the copies must agree on every entry, even while machines crash and messages get lost.
谁也说不清，所以副本必须对每一条都达成一致，哪怕机器在崩、消息在丢。
Now cut the network between notebook one and the other two. Both sides keep working.
现在把第一本和另外两本之间的网络切断。两边都还在工作。
They must not both think they're in charge, or the record splits in two.
两边不能都以为自己说了算，否则记录就分裂成两份。
Getting copies to agree like this is called consensus: Paxos in episodes 13 and 14, Raft from episode 15.
让副本这样达成一致，叫做共识：Paxos 在第 13、14 集，Raft 从第 15 集开始。
visual: Corner: marker 4 lit. Toy: three notebooks, then a cut between them.

title: Five Labs on One Board
zh: 五个 Lab 对上这块板子
lines: Lab 1, MapReduce, is the job we just split: markers 1 and 2, crashed workers and duplicate writers.
Lab 1 MapReduce 就是刚才拆开的任务：标记 1 和 2，worker 崩溃、重复写入。
Lab 2, a key-value server, lives entirely in marker 3: what to do when Call says false.
Lab 2 键值服务器整个都在标记 3 里：Call 返回 false 时该怎么办。
Lab 3, Raft, is marker 4: replicas that agree despite crashes and lost messages.
Lab 3 Raft 是标记 4：机器崩、消息丢，副本照样一致。
Lab 4 puts the key-value service on top of Raft, so it survives crashes.
Lab 4 把键值服务放到 Raft 上，让它挺过崩溃。
Lab 5 shards it across groups, to win back the speed we started for.
Lab 5 把它分片到多个组，把最初想要的速度赢回来。
visual: The full framework page; column L lights lab by lab, a line from each lab to its markers.

title: Finding Your Way in src/
lines: Everything lives in src/. Some folders are given to you; you never edit them.
所有代码都在 src/ 里。有些目录是发给你的，你不用改。
Everything lives in the source folder. Some folders are given to you; you never edit them.
labrpc is the fake network. tester1 runs your servers, crashes them and checks them.
labrpc 是假网络。tester1 负责启动、弄崩、检查你的服务器。
lab R P C is the fake network. tester one runs your servers, crashes them and checks them.
mrapps holds the plugins, like wc.go. main holds the books and the little launchers.
mrapps 放插件，比如 wc.go；main 放那几本书和启动程序。
M R apps holds the plugins, like W C dot go. Main holds the books and the little launchers.
Your files are the ones with comments like "Your code here". There are ten of them.
你要写的文件，就是带着 "Your code here" 这类注释的那些，一共十个。
Your files are the ones with comments like, your code here. There are ten of them.
data.py: ten files with "Your code here"
For Lab 1, that's mr/coordinator.go and mr/worker.go. Right now MakeCoordinator only starts its RPC server.
Lab 1 是 mr/coordinator.go 和 mr/worker.go。现在 MakeCoordinator 只启动了 RPC 服务，别的都要你写。
For Lab 1, that's coordinator dot go and worker dot go in the M R folder. Right now, Make Coordinator only starts its R P C server.
mr/coordinator.go:52–60
make mr builds the launchers and the plugins, then runs the Lab 1 tests with the race detector on.
make mr 会编译启动程序和插件，然后打开竞争检测器跑 Lab 1 的测试。
And make M R builds the launchers and the plugins, then runs the Lab 1 tests with the race detector on.
Makefile:43–57

title: Recap, on the Page
lines: One: one machine does our eight books in a fraction of a second. We distribute for scale, not for small jobs.
一：一台机器零点几秒数完八本书。分布式是为了规模，不是为了小任务。
One: one machine does our eight books in a fraction of a second. We distribute for scale, not for small jobs.
Two: the price is four markers: failure, concurrency, an unreliable network, agreement.
二：代价是四个标记：故障、并发、不可靠的网络、一致。
Three: a false from Call can mean "never ran" or "ran, reply lost". Design for both.
三：Call 返回 false 可能是“没执行”，也可能是“执行了但回复丢了”。两种都要考虑。
Three: a false from Call can mean never ran, or ran and the reply was lost. Design for both.
visual: The full framework page. Each takeaway lights its part.

title: Your Turn
lines: Build wc.so and run mrsequential on the eight books yourself.
自己编译 wc.so，在八本书上跑一遍 mrsequential。
Build the word count plugin and run the sequential version on the eight books yourself.
Before you look: how many times does "Sherlock" appear?
先别看："Sherlock" 出现了几次？
Before you look: how many times does Sherlock appear?
pause
97. Grep mr-out-0 to check. Next episode: the MapReduce model, one bucket at a time.
97 次。grep 一下 mr-out-0 就能核对。下一集：MapReduce 模型，一个桶一个桶地看。
Ninety-seven. Grep the output file to check. Next episode: the Map Reduce model, one bucket at a time.
